neet_phy_u18_t02_3.working: Period T is proportional to n^3/Z^2. Going from n = 1 to n = 2 multiplies T by 2^3 = 8.

neet_phy_u18_t02_4.working: Both statements are true. Substituting λ = h/mv into 2πr = nλ gives mvr = nh/2π, so the de Broglie condition explains Bohr's quantisation rule. This is the standard textbook interpretation; Bohr himself stated the rule as a postulate.

neet_phy_u18_t02_5.working: Statement I: ionisation energy = 13.6 × 3^2 = 122.4 eV, so it is correct. Statement II: v is proportional to Z/n, and 2/2 = 1, so v equals hydrogen's first-orbit speed, about c/137 (≈ 2.19×10^6 m/s). It is correct.
